declaration.preface:
At Quality Rubbers, we are committed to environmental responsibility and sustainable operations. We recognize that rubber processing activities including material handling, energy consumption, waste generation, and transportation can have an impact on the environment. Accordingly, we strive to minimize these impacts through responsible practices, efficient resource utilization, and continuous improvement.

We believe that integrating sustainability into our operations is essential for long‑term business success as well as environmental protection. This policy reflects our commitment to reducing environmental impact, optimizing the use of natural resources, and promoting responsible processing and logistics practices.

By embedding environmental considerations into all aspects of our operations from material handling and processing to transportation and waste management Quality Rubbers aims to operate responsibly and contribute towards a more sustainable future.
declaration.scope: This policy applies to all employees, workers, directors, officers, contractors, and any third parties acting on behalf of Quality Rubbers. It covers all business activities associated with the Company’s operations, including sourcing of raw rubber materials, cleaning and upgrading processes, storage, handling, transportation, and dispatch of materials, as well as interactions with customers, suppliers, regulatory authorities, and other stakeholders.

Sustainable Raw Material Sourcing: We aim to promote responsible sourcing of natural and synthetic rubber by encouraging procurement from certified suppliers, ensuring traceability, and supporting practices that help prevent deforestation and biodiversity loss.

We aim to improve energy efficiency by monitoring energy consumption, optimizing processes, enhancing equipment efficiency, and adopting energy-saving and renewable energy solutions wherever feasible.
We aim to measure and reduce greenhouse gas emissions (Scope 1 and Scope 2) through cleaner fuels, operational improvements, and promotion of low-carbon initiatives.
We aim to control air emissions by using appropriate pollution control systems, monitoring key pollutants such as particulate matter and VOCs, and ensuring regulatory compliance.
We aim to strengthen water stewardship by promoting efficient use, reuse and recycling of water, and ensuring proper treatment of wastewater before discharge.
We aim to minimize waste generation by improving process efficiency, promoting recycling and reuse of materials, and ensuring safe disposal of hazardous and non-hazardous waste.
We aim to ensure safe chemical management through proper storage, labeling, handling practices, and reduction of hazardous substances wherever alternatives exist.
We aim to support biodiversity protection by avoiding sourcing from ecologically sensitive areas and encouraging conservation practices across stakeholders.
We aim to ensure environmental compliance through adherence to applicable laws, monitoring of environmental performance, and internal audits.
We aim to promote environmental awareness and engagement by encouraging employee participation, supporting community initiatives, and strengthening sustainability communication.

policy.monitoring:
At Quality Rubbers, monitoring and reporting are integral to ensuring effective environmental management and continuous performance improvement across our operations. We maintain structured processes to track, review, and communicate our environmental performance.

Performance Tracking: Environmental parameters related to energy consumption, water usage, waste generation, and emissions are regularly monitored against defined performance indicators.

Periodic Reviews: Environmental data is reviewed at defined intervals to assess progress, identify gaps, and support informed decision-making.

Internal Audits: Routine internal audits are conducted to evaluate compliance with regulatory requirements and the effectiveness of operational controls.

Data Integrity and Documentation: Accurate records and documentation systems are maintained to ensure reliability and traceability of environmental data.

Stakeholder Communication: We engage with employees, customers, regulatory authorities, and local communities to share information, address concerns, and strengthen transparency.

Performance Disclosure: Environmental performance and key initiatives are communicated through internal reporting systems and external disclosures, where applicable.
policy.reviewMechanism:
The Environmental Policy is subject to periodic review to ensure its continued relevance, effectiveness, and alignment with regulatory requirements and organizational objectives.

The Environmental Officer is responsible for coordinating the review process.

The policy is reviewed at least once every year or earlier, if required, based on regulatory changes, operational developments, or stakeholder feedback.

The review process includes assessment of compliance status, progress against environmental performance goals, and identification of improvement opportunities.

Necessary updates and revisions are implemented to strengthen the policy and ensure alignment with best practices.
